App concept
  1. Your products. Her pocket.

    Be the brand she gifts.

    When the PinkOut app launches, women in Riyadh shop beauty, fashion, gifts and treats from brands picked for her world. Follow one order from her first tap to her review.

    • A shop in the app
    • Paid in the app
    • Delivered in Riyadh
    • Rated by her

    Scroll to follow her order

  2. 01
    Step 1 of 7She opens the shop

    She starts with who it is for.

    Beauty, fashion, accessories, sweets, gifts and lifestyle, picked for her world. She searches "birthday gift".

    What you get

    • A shop in the categories she browses
    • Found when she searches
    • Your catalogue, your prices

    The value for you

    • Found by search
    • A women-first audience
    • Open all year round
  3. 02
    Step 2 of 7Featured

    Your brand, in the Gift Edit.

    Featured moments, like gift edits and themed-day picks, put your products in front of her first.

    What you get

    • A place in gift edits
    • Themed-day picks
    • Your product leads the row

    The value for you

    • Seen at gifting moments
    • Your product first
    • Picks that feel curated

    Step 3 of 7Your story

    She meets Your brand.

    Your brand page, with your story, your products and your ratings, tells her who made it. That is what makes her choose you.

    • A brand page with your story
    • Your logo and your look
    • Your full range in one place

    • Followed by her

    Step 4 of 7The product

    • Add to bag in one tap

    Step 5 of 7Checkout

    Paid in a minute.

    She sends it as a gift to her friend's address with a note, sees the full price with delivery and pays in the app. The order lands in your dashboard.

    What you get

    • Orders straight to your dashboard
    • Gift notes and wrapping flagged
    • Paid through the app

    The value for you

    • Payment handled
    • Gift orders made easy
    • Every order in one place
  7. 06
    Step 6 of 7Tuesday

    She follows it to the door.

    You confirm and pack it; she sees every step as it happens: confirmed, gift-wrapped, shipped, delivered.

    What you get

    • Update the status as you go
    • Tracking shared with her
    • Questions in one place

    The value for you

    • Fewer "where is it?" messages
    • On-time delivery
    • A gift that feels cared for
  8. 07
    Step 7 of 7After

    And she comes back.

    The gift lands, she rates Your brand, her friend asks where it came from, and you are one tap away for both of them.

    What you get

    • Reviews on your brand page
    • Earnings and payouts in one view
    • Customers who order again

    The value for you

    • Reputation that grows
    • Earnings tracked
    • Repeat orders
One order, three views

One order. Three views.

When she orders, the same order shows in her app, in your shop dashboard and at PinkOut. Play it from checkout to review.

  • CustomerShe finds Your brand in the app, sees the full price, pays in the app and follows the order to her door.
  • Your shopOrders, stock and earnings in one place, with what you need to send the order.
  • PinkOutPinkOut runs checkout, keeps her updated and records your earnings and payout for every order.

When plans change

  • CancelledBefore it ships: she's refunded and nothing is sent.
  • Out of stockShe's told at once and refunded.
  • ReturnedThe refund shows on the order and in your earnings.
  • Running lateShe sees the new delivery date.

FAQ

Good questions, clear answers.

What exactly is PinkOut?

A women-first lifestyle, creativity and entertainment destination coming soon to Riyadh, with seven experience zones and an app in development.

When and where does it open?

In Riyadh. The exact date and venue will be announced once confirmed.

What are the fees or commission?

Commercial terms are shared after you apply, in the deck for your partner type.

Are any partners confirmed?

No partnerships have been announced yet.

When can I sell in the app?

When the PinkOut app launches. Shop partners sell through the app.

Can I sell at the event?

Not as an Shop partner: selling happens in the PinkOut app. If your brand wants a presence at the event, enquire as an event partner.

What can I sell?

Products that fit PinkOut's categories: beauty, fashion, accessories, sweets and treats, gifts and lifestyle.
